pages.title: Current Features
pages.text: Here are ways to learn, transform, travel, fight, feed, and work by the forge. All three dragon types and both sexes have human forms at stages three to five.$(br2)Read $(l:dragonmaid:getting_started/milestones)your keepsakes$(/l) for milestones.

pages.title: Planned Features
pages.text: Knowledge levels two and three are available, each unlocking an accessory slot. Find the requirements in $(l:dragonmaid:learning/books)Lessons and Lore$(/l).$(br2)Higher knowledge levels, extra storage, weapons, riding, and new ways to spend time together await a future update.

pages.title: Guide Illustrations
pages.text: Landscapes and moments from your travels have found a place in this book. More stories are waiting for you to write them together.
